reading: A review ordered by the government could lead to some young people receiving less financial support.
According to the Times, Alan Milburn's report will recommend moving people under 25 off the main sickness and disability benefits.
Milburn has been asked to help reduce the number of young adults who are not in education, employment or training.
Under the proposals, young people would receive an allowance at the same standard rate as universal credit.
Some could qualify for an additional allowance to cover everyday costs linked to their health conditions.
People with more severe disabilities who cannot work would receive a new benefit at a higher rate.
The report is also expected to recommend billions in spending on employment support, including work placements and personal advisers.
Milburn said the changes would affect both existing claimants and people making new claims.
Young people could lose some financial support if they did not take part in the employment support offered.
If the recommendations were approved, it could take almost ten years for the government to save money.
Milburn said the new system would require significant investment and would need to be built again from the beginning.
A government spokesperson promised to keep support available for people who most need protection and those unable to work.

vocabulary.definition: Money given to help someone pay for things they need.
Plans or suggestions that people will consider before deciding what to do.
An amount of money given regularly to help someone meet their needs.
Meet the conditions needed to receive something.
Very serious and causing major difficulties.
Cause something to happen or produce a particular result.
People who apply for or receive money through a government support system.
Money spent now to improve something for the future.

entries.ja: 必要なものの費用を払えるように、人に与えられるお金。
entries.ko: 누군가가 필요한 것의 비용을 낼 수 있도록 주는 돈.
entries.zh-Hans: 为帮助某人支付所需物品或服务的费用而提供的钱。
entries.es: Dinero que se da a alguien para ayudarle a pagar lo que necesita.
entries.pt-BR: Dinheiro dado a alguém para ajudar a pagar aquilo de que precisa.
entries.fr: Argent donné à une personne pour l’aider à payer ce dont elle a besoin.
entries.de: Geld, das jemand erhält, um Dinge bezahlen zu können, die er braucht.

entries.ja: 何をするかを決める前に、人々が検討する計画や提案。
entries.ko: 무엇을 할지 결정하기 전에 사람들이 검토할 계획이나 제안.
entries.zh-Hans: 人们在决定采取什么行动之前会考虑的计划或建议。
entries.es: Planes o sugerencias que las personas considerarán antes de decidir qué hacer.
entries.pt-BR: Planos ou sugestões que as pessoas vão considerar antes de decidir o que fazer.
entries.fr: Plans ou suggestions que les personnes examineront avant de décider quoi faire.
entries.de: Pläne oder Vorschläge, die Menschen prüfen werden, bevor sie entscheiden, was sie tun.

entries.ja: 必要なものをまかなえるように、定期的に与えられる一定額のお金。
entries.ko: 누군가가 필요한 것을 마련할 수 있도록 정기적으로 주는 일정 금액의 돈.
entries.zh-Hans: 为帮助某人满足生活所需而定期发放的一笔钱。
entries.es: Cantidad de dinero que se da regularmente a alguien para ayudarle a cubrir sus necesidades.
entries.pt-BR: Quantia de dinheiro dada regularmente a alguém para ajudar a suprir suas necessidades.
entries.fr: Somme d’argent versée régulièrement à une personne pour l’aider à subvenir à ses besoins.
entries.de: Ein Geldbetrag, den jemand regelmäßig erhält, um seine Bedürfnisse decken zu können.

entries.ja: 何かを受け取るために必要な条件を満たすこと。
entries.ko: 무언가를 받는 데 필요한 조건을 충족하다.
entries.zh-Hans: 满足获得某种东西所需的条件。
entries.es: Cumplir las condiciones necesarias para recibir algo.
entries.pt-BR: Atender às condições necessárias para receber algo.
entries.fr: Remplir les conditions nécessaires pour recevoir quelque chose.
entries.de: Die notwendigen Voraussetzungen erfüllen, um etwas zu erhalten.

entries.ja: 非常に深刻で、大きな困難を引き起こす。
entries.zh-Hans: 非常严重，并造成很大的困难。
entries.es: Muy grave y que causa grandes dificultades.
entries.pt-BR: Muito grave e que causa grandes dificuldades.
entries.fr: Très grave et qui entraîne de grandes difficultés.
entries.de: Sehr schwerwiegend und große Schwierigkeiten verursachend.

entries.ja: 何かを起こしたり、特定の結果をもたらしたりすること。
entries.ko: 어떤 일이 일어나게 하거나 특정한 결과를 가져오다.
entries.zh-Hans: 使某件事发生，或产生某种特定的结果。
entries.es: Hacer que algo ocurra o producir un resultado determinado.
entries.pt-BR: Fazer algo acontecer ou produzir um resultado específico.
entries.fr: Faire se produire quelque chose ou entraîner un résultat particulier.
entries.de: Bewirken, dass etwas geschieht, oder zu einem bestimmten Ergebnis führen.

entries.ja: 政府の支援制度を通じて、お金の支給を申請する人々、または支給を受けている人々。
entries.ko: 정부 지원 제도를 통해 금전 지원을 신청하거나 받는 사람들.
entries.zh-Hans: 通过政府援助制度申请或领取补助金的人。
entries.es: Personas que solicitan o reciben dinero a través de un sistema de ayuda del gobierno.
entries.pt-BR: Pessoas que solicitam ou recebem dinheiro por meio de um sistema de apoio do governo.
entries.fr: Personnes qui demandent ou reçoivent de l’argent dans le cadre d’un système d’aide publique.
entries.de: Menschen, die im Rahmen eines staatlichen Unterstützungssystems Geld beantragen oder erhalten.

entries.ja: 将来に向けて何かを改善するために、今使うお金。
entries.ko: 미래를 위해 무언가를 개선하려고 지금 쓰는 돈.
entries.zh-Hans: 为了让某事物在未来变得更好而现在投入的钱。
entries.es: Dinero que se gasta ahora para mejorar algo de cara al futuro.
entries.pt-BR: Dinheiro gasto agora para melhorar algo para o futuro.
entries.fr: Argent dépensé maintenant pour améliorer quelque chose en vue de l’avenir.
entries.de: Geld, das jetzt ausgegeben wird, um etwas für die Zukunft zu verbessern.
